cog_components.region: bottom left of the original last-sheet target

method: Construct exactly 18 quarter-turned frames in four columns, two of four frames and two of five. Derive 8-cog and 4-cog components as specified subsets of an already audited aligned 15-cog lattice, preserving every local transform before translation normalization. Place them above the shorter and taller column pairs with a 0.225mm bounding clearance. Place the saved three-cog row at the last-sheet lower left. Recompute every original member, allowed transform, stock bound and all same-sheet filled-outer pairs, and validate the resulting 33-part subassembly with the frozen original CLI. Report historical four-tall-column frame patterns when present; do not claim a first-ever frame orientation. No bracket/insert completion or solver is performed. This prepares a changed construction after the all-wide-frame candidate searches; it is not a full-job witness, production repair or native-margin qualification.
